## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A thread whose concern is visibly resolved in the current file diff is...

The system SHALL ensure that a thread whose concern is visibly resolved in the current file diff is classified already_addressed and triggers no delegation, covered by a fixture in the execute_plan tests.

#### Scenario: A thread whose concern is visibly resolved in the current file diff is...

WHEN `triage-merge-review-threads-by-required-response` is implemented
THEN A thread whose concern is visibly resolved in the current file diff is classified already_addressed and triggers no delegation, covered by a fixture in the execute_plan tests.

### Requirement: staleness_gate, security_gate and live_state_gate run before any decision...

The system SHALL ensure that staleness_gate, security_gate and live_state_gate run before any decision call and their outcomes are unaffected, asserted by a call-ordering test.

#### Scenario: staleness_gate, security_gate and live_state_gate run before any decision...

WHEN `triage-merge-review-threads-by-required-response` is implemented
THEN staleness_gate, security_gate and live_state_gate run before any decision call and their outcomes are unaffected, asserted by a call-ordering test.

### Requirement: Threads below act_floor fall through to delegation rather than being...

The system SHALL ensure that threads below act_floor fall through to delegation rather than being silently closed.

#### Scenario: Threads below act_floor fall through to delegation rather than being...

WHEN `triage-merge-review-threads-by-required-response` is implemented
THEN Threads below act_floor fall through to delegation rather than being silently closed.

### Requirement: With the helper returning None every unresolved thread is delegated exactly...

The system SHALL ensure that with the helper returning None every unresolved thread is delegated exactly as today, proven by existing execute_plan tests.

#### Scenario: With the helper returning None every unresolved thread is delegated exactly...

WHEN `triage-merge-review-threads-by-required-response` is implemented
THEN With the helper returning None every unresolved thread is delegated exactly as today, proven by existing execute_plan tests.
